name: kit-status
description: A status-bar counter and a short flash when an ai-dev-kit skill, command or script is used. Reads the feature-usage log; no model, no tokens.

commands.title: AI Dev Kit: Show features used in this window
AI Dev Kit: Usage notices on / off

kitStatus.popup.description: Show a notification popup on first use of a feature instead of a short flash in the status bar.

kitStatus.allProjects.description: Count features used in any project, not only the folder open in this window.
